svg.text: VulcaTrack: Sales and Inventory with On-the-Go Services
D1 customers D2 admins D3 vehicles D4 items
D5 Sales & Line Items (sales + sale_items) D6 service_requests D7 tiremen
Customer – submits OTG service requests; manages own profile and vehicles.
Admin – runs the shop: POS, inventory, and OTG request handling (incl. the Tireman roster).
• OTG requires an authenticated customer, a saved vehicle and a shared location (latitude /
longitude). The ETA is calculated once at request time and stored as a frozen snapshot –
never recalculated. No live GPS tracking; no route geometry is stored.
• Request statuses: pending, accepted, rejected, completed. A Tireman is a record in D7
assigned by the Admin – not a system user (no Tireman login or dashboard).
• POS: online / GCash payment is out of scope; walk-in sales need no customer account.
Product sale lines deduct D4 stock; service lines do not. Deactivation replaces delete (D3, D4, D7).
